name: exec-productivity
description: An executive's daily operating routines, run by Claude in Cowork. A guided install that ends on your first brief, a Super Context your assistant starts every session from (priorities, live topics, people, decisions), a daily brief every weekday morning, a priority inbox across mail and chat four times a day, and a Friday review that finds the asks a connection would have answered. Reads your mail, calendar, chat, documents and meetings. Sends nothing, deletes nothing.
